why_new: Existing replies establish visible upper Foam, internal texture at Y833, and the upper neighboring glass feature. None approves a source-position interval for the true upper Foam at X595 in this frame.

renderer_source:
"""Render a source-position question using the existing native-pixel review layout."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ROOT=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
D=ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=read(D/'2026-10-11-p2-shared-support/preflight.json')
image_path=ROOT/pre['images']['1620']['original_roi']
assert sha(image_path)==pre['inputs'][str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT))]
paths=[image_path,ROOT/'sample/sample4.oilrecipe',
       D/'2026-10-09-foam-texture-reply.json',
       D/'2026-10-09-foam-upper-visibility-reply.json',
       D/'2026-10-09-foam-gap-upper-side-reply.json',
       D/'2026-10-11-p2-shared-support/preflight.json']
pins={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in paths}
recipe=read(ROOT/'sample/sample4.oilrecipe')
cx=math.floor(recipe['glasses'][0]['geometry']['ellipse']['center_x']+.5)
assert cx==595
texture=read(D/'2026-10-09-foam-texture-reply.json')
assert next(r for r in texture['reviewed_guides'] if r['frame_index']==1620)['original_sha256']==sha(image_path)
original=Image.open(image_path).convert('RGB'); assert original.size==(104,104)
detail=original.resize((624,624),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1440,895),'#f4f7fc');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
font_path='/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
def font(n):
    if Path(font_path).exists():
        return ImageFont.truetype(font_path,n)
    return ImageFont.load_default(size=n)
draw.text((24,18),'sample4 / 54.0 s: Foam upper-front position',font=font(29),fill='#15283c')
draw.text((24,58),'The visible upper boundary is already confirmed. This asks only about its center position.',font=font(22),fill='#365168')
draw.text((24,100),'Clean original pixels / 6x nearest enlargement',font=font(22),fill='#15283c')
draw.text((768,100),'Same pixels + proposed position range',font=font(22),fill='#15283c')
left=(24,140);right=(768,140)
canvas.paste(detail,left);canvas.paste(detail,right)
xx=right[0]+(cx-543)*6+2.5
for y in range(right[1],right[1]+624,13):
    draw.line((xx,y,xx,min(y+6,right[1]+623)),fill='#00ffff',width=2)
top=right[1]+(812-798)*6; bottom=right[1]+(817-798)*6-1
draw.rectangle((xx-11,top,xx+11,bottom),outline='#ffff00',width=2)
draw.line((xx+12,(top+bottom)/2,xx+75,(top+bottom)/2),fill='#ffff00',width=2)
draw.text((xx+80,top),'812-816',font=font(20),fill='#ffff00')
draw.text((24,788),'104 x 104 native pixels. No sharpening or color adjustment.',font=font(20),fill='#365168')
draw.text((768,788),'Cyan: fixed center X595 / yellow: rows 812-816',font=font(21),fill='#15283c')
draw.text((24,840),'Yellow is a proposed uncertainty range. An unclear position is an acceptable answer.',font=font(22),fill='#365168')
figure=D/'2026-10-11-foam-upper-position-review.png';assert not figure.exists();canvas.save(figure)
stored=Image.open(figure).convert('RGB')
assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(stored.crop((24,140,648,764))),np.repeat(np.repeat(np.asarray(original),6,0),6,1))
for p in paths:assert sha(p)==pins[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]
record=dict(schema='s11-source-position-review-v1',status='PENDING_HUMAN_POSITION_QUALIFICATION',
            preparation_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
            source=dict(video='sample/sample4.mp4',frame_index=1620,time_sec=54.0,
                        raster=str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)),raster_sha256=sha(image_path),
                        crop_origin_xy=[543,798],crop_shape=[104,104],source_x=cx),
            proposed_rows_inclusive=[812,816],proposed_y_cell_bounds=[811.5,816.5],
            proposal_authority='Agent visual interpretation of the clean source and the already reviewed upper-gap context. Approximate regional position; not a new accepted numeric label.',
            purpose='P5 raw-front prerequisite: qualify a target-domain positive at the fixed column before scoring whether a current observed front is preserved. Keep episodes and production unchanged.',
            why_new='Existing replies establish visible upper Foam, internal texture at Y833, and the upper neighboring glass feature. None approves a source-position interval for the true upper Foam at X595 in this frame.',
            question_ko='sample4의 54초 장면에서, 청록색 중앙선과 만나는 실제 거품 윗경계의 위치를 노란 범위(Y812–816) 안으로 판단할 수 있나요? 흐려서 위치를 특정하기 어려우면 불명확으로 남기겠습니다.',
            offered_answers=['표시한 범위로 판단 가능','표시한 범위와 다름','영상만으로 위치 판별 불가'],
            scope='One frame and fixed source column only. Box width is display decoration, not reviewed X support. No dense contour, exact Y, thickness, neighboring-frame truth or automatic front selector follows.',
            existing_replies_preserved=True,inputs=pins,
            figure=dict(path=str(figure.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=sha(figure),size=list(canvas.size)),
            verification=dict(clean_panel_exact_nearest_pixels=True,input_hashes_preserved=True,
                              detector_executed=False,video_decoded=False),
            renderer_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
            renderer_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),numeric_truth=None,production_changed=False,
            legacy_truth_changed=False,windows_required=False)
record_path=D/'2026-10-11-foam-upper-position-review.json';assert not record_path.exists()
record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'figure':record['figure'],'pending':True,'source_x':cx,'rows':[812,816]},indent=2))
